newsitem.title: FRANCE: Two British teenagers die in French bus crash.
newsitem.headline: Two British teenagers die in French bus crash.

text.p: Two British teenagers were killed and one person seriously injured when a bus carrying children on a school trip veered off a road in eastern France on Monday, paramilitary gendarmes said.
Lieutenant-Colonel Bernard Belondrade said the bus left the road near the town of Moutiers and fell 20 metres (60 feet) into a ravine, eventually coming to rest on its side against a tree.
It was carrying 23 passengers from a nearby holiday camp to a rock-climbing site. The remaining 20 people were less seriously injured.
Schoolgirl Nicola Moore, 16, died almost immediately and Robert Boardman,14, died in hospital later.
Transport minister Jean-Claude Gayssot visited injured children in hospital in the early evening.
The victims were all from the northern British town of Bolton. The cause of the accident was not immediately known and the gendarmes were due to question the driver, who was also from Britain.
